item.tib: gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi don rab tu gsal ba byed pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed
item.coloph: gzhi lam 'bras bu gsum gyi don rab tu gsal bar byed pa'i rnam bshad thar lam gsal byed zhes bya ba 'di ni/ snga gong du don gnyer can gyi slob ma 'gas bskul ba la gzhi byas/ dus phyis sdom brtson sde snod 'dzin pa chen po mdo smad pa'i slob dpon nam mkha' rin chen gyis bskul ba'i ngor/ dpal ldan bzang po ri yi btsun pa rgyal mtshan mchog legs kyis/ mtha' bzhi snga bshad stod kyi sa cha bshad sgrab gling du sbyar ba 'dis kyang kun mkhyen rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che dar zhing rgyas la yun ring du gnas par gyur cig gzhi lam 'bras bu gsal byed snyan tshig zhes bya ba rdzogs so//
